messages:
maria_csm: quick sync on OpalMetrics acct 892 renewal. They want 12mo -> 9mo, prorated. Procurement asks for vendor_code + PO. Buyer prefers DocuSign but EU team may require witness. low adoption flagged. cc @sarah_sales @jon_finance.
sarah_sales: customer okay with list price if prorated. propose 1x onboarding credit instead of discount to protect ARR.
jon_finance: confirm payment method. they prefer wire (international). if wire, mark as payment-pending until funds clear. need billing entity + VAT.
lee_legal: e-sign ok for EU generally. if buyer policy needs witness, accept scanned witnessed wet signature + attestation. i'll add fallback clause to SOW addendum.
devon_se: enablement ready. recommend workshop week after cleared payment: 2hr kickoff + 30d follow-up.
tina_procurement: OPAL-INTL-502 is our vendor code. I'll push PO this week, prefer wire.
procurement_bot: PO template provided.
maria_csm: proposed deal: 9mo at list, prorated invoice, plus 1x $2k onboarding credit if signed by EoM. SE gated on payment clearance. action items: Legal add clause (lee), Finance confirm clearance rules (jon), Sales collect PO + ETA (sarah). I'll update playbook and CRM risk = medium.
sarah_sales: pinging buyer for PO number and wire ETA.
jon_finance: noted, expect 3-5bd for international wire. we'll set contract effective date to cleared payment date.
maria_csm: thanks all. I'll reply to buyer with proposed wording and await PO. :thumbsup:
